Subject: OncoAI Dedicated Pool: sizing & rollout plan

Hi Markus / Monica,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. We need a dedicated GPU pool for our inference stack (image oncology model). High level:
- Baseline QPS: 120 rps (p50 latency target 150ms)
- Peak: spikes to ~360 rps for sustained windows of 20-40 minutes during batch runs
- Region preference: eu-west-1 primary, fall back to us-east-1 if needed
- Data residency: everything must remain in our VPC during inference

Can you share a recommended pool sizing and autoscale/burst policy? Also would like your suggested canary rollout plan — we need minimal risk during initial cutover. Attached is a traffic slice for the last 30 days (oncoai-map-traffic.csv).

High-level timeline we'd like: start implementation in Oct, pilot by mid-Oct, GA by early Nov.

Thanks,
Sana

Head of Infrastructure, OncoAI

Hi Sana — thanks for the data and timeline. I've sketched a mutual action plan below and attached our multipool templates + a draft SOW to accelerate procurement.

Mutual action plan (high level)
1) Week 1 (Oct 4–8): sizing verification + VPC peering & network checks
2) Week 2: pool provisioning & baseline performance testing (10% canary)
3) Week 3: incremental canary expansion (10% -> 50%) + load soak
4) Week 4: GA cutover + post-cutover runbook handoff

Recommended starting config (subject to final infra audit)
- Pool: 12 x A40-equivalent GPUs (baseline) — this gives ~120 rps baseline with headroom for model KV cache
- Burst: allow 2x pooled GPUs for 30 min windows (max sustain) with a 15-min cooldown
- Autoscale triggers: CPU/GPU util > 70% and queue length > 50 requests for 3 consecutive minutes
- Canary: 10% traffic for 48–72h -> 50% for 24h -> 100%

Deliverables we will provide:
- provisioning playbook (runbook + IaC snippets)
- validation scripts for p50/p95 latency and throughput
- rollback and fallback to hosted variants if capacity constrained

I've attached: redwood-multipool-templates.pdf (server profiles & autoscale policy examples), SOW-draft-v1.docx (commercial + timeline).

Next steps: if this looks good, Monica and I will align with Infra on the VPC peering checklist and schedule a 60-min kickoff once procurement signs.

-markus

Markus Klein
Head of Dedicated Onboarding, Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.ai

Date: 2026-09-29T14:20:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: OncoAI pool - kernels, kv cache & autoscale knobs

Monica / Priyom — forwarding Sana's traffic and our proposed plan. A few technical points we should lock down before the kickoff:

1) Model profile: Imagenet-derived oncology model; tokens per request skew low but sequence length variable up to 1024. That favors larger KV caches and attention kernel that supports memory-friendly execution.
2) Quantization: prefer int8 for cost but need regression tests for quality — add to validation script set.
3) Batching policy: continuous batching with dynamic per-model max batch 64, but upper cap set by latency SLO.
4) Autoscale policy refinement: implement a two-tier scale (fast scale up using burst capacity, conservative scale down with cooldown 15m). Also add prefix cache hit ratio as a signal to avoid unnecessary scale-ups during predictable windows.

Question for Priyom: can Ops schedule a maintenance window the week of Oct 11 for the baseline soak? We should also pre-provision the fallback hosted routes in case onboarding hits quota limits.

I'll incorporate your notes into the runbook and push updated IaC snippets to the drive folder linked below.

-Markus

Sana — following internal alignment, here's a tighter operational plan and schedule.

Operational plan highlights
- Primary region: eu-west-1 (VPC peering + ENI allocation)
- Secondary region: us-east-1 (automated fallback routing, cold standby pool)
- Provisioning target: 12 GPUs baseline (12 x A40 equiv); we will reserve 4 additional GPUs as hot-burst capacity (available via autoscale policy)
- Burst policy: +100% capacity (2x) for up to 30 minutes per incident; max 3 incidents per 24h before escalation to on-call.
- Canary: 10% traffic (48h) -> 50% (24h) -> 100% (post-validation)
- Rollback: instant route swap to hosted generation variant + drain pool within 10 minutes

Schedule (proposal)
- Oct 4–8: infra audit, VPC peering tests, IAM & KMS key test
- Oct 11–15: provision pool, basic validation (p50/p95), run quantization A/B tests
- Oct 18–22: canary 10% -> 50% expansion + soak tests
- Oct 25: GA (tentative)

Things we need from OncoAI this week:
- Final SOW sign-off or comments (we attached SOW-draft-v1.docx)
- DocuSign for the commitment and a primary POC for network coordination
- Confirmation of maintenance window Oct 11–15 for the soak

I'll create the kickoff invite once we have sign-off. If you'd like, we can also include an ops deep-dive session for Priyom's team.

Best,
Markus
